name: GeoMacro Global Risk Intelligence Agent
description: 24/7 machine-readable geopolitical, macroeconomic and critical-mineral risk intelligence for AI agents. GeoMacro checks deliverability before any payable x402 challenge and fails closed when required evidence is stale, incomplete, unverifiable or commercially ineligible.

extensions.description: Paid intelligence delivery uses x402 v2 only after no-charge deliverability validation.

skills.name: Global Geopolitical Risk Intelligence
skills.description: Country, corridor, conflict, sanctions, governance, security, trade-disruption and governed hot-topic intelligence when the required evidence bundle is currently deliverable.
examples: Assess current geopolitical and security risks for a country
Check a strategic corridor for current disruption risk

skills.name: Global Macro and FX Risk Intelligence
skills.description: Macro, monetary, sovereign/fiscal, external and FX vulnerability intelligence for supported subjects with freshness, provenance and commercial-eligibility gates.
examples: What are the current macro and FX risks for India?
Assess sovereign and external vulnerability for a supported country

skills.name: Global Critical Minerals Risk Intelligence
skills.description: Critical-mineral supply, concentration, policy, disruption and cross-border risk intelligence where governed source coverage is current and commercially eligible.
examples: Assess critical-mineral supply risk affecting a country or corridor

skills.name: No-Charge Deliverability Preflight
skills.description: Determine whether a requested GeoMacro intelligence bundle is currently deliverable before any payment is requested.
examples: Can GeoMacro currently answer this query without stale or missing modules?
